  1. jaba

Uses of Class
jaba.JabaModel

Packages that use JabaModel
Package
Description
jaba
The JABA tool: identification of bottlenecks in multiclass closed product form networks using efficient convex hull algorithms, as described in the user manual.
jaba.graphs
Graphical components of JABA: two and three dimensional graphs of the saturation sectors and of the convex hull of the model.
jaba.link
Link component of the JABA graphical interface.
jaba.panels
Panels of the JABA wizard: Classes, Stations, Service Times, Performance Indices, Sectors and Convex Hull views described in the JABA chapter of the user manual.
